CHAR-BUG-001.title: Turn was not atomic: <=3 conditional mid-turn save_sheet calls across multiple call sites
CHAR-BUG-001.behavior: WAS: one AI-path turn persisted the sheet from several sites (session __init__, _finish, then conditionally _execute_ai_tutor for introduce-marked / first_seen / resolve-enqueue writes) instead of one commit point; a crash mid-turn could leave e.g. an introduce planted without the later writes. NOW: the recorder stage family ends in stage_sheet_commit -> ConversationalSession._commit_sheet -- AT MOST ONE durable sheet persist per successful turn, after every recorder stage wrote its fields into the in-memory sheet. Crash semantics changed DELIBERATELY (Grok round-1 (a) amendment, BINDING): 'the turn commits or it doesn't' -- a crash mid-turn leaves the previous turn's sheet on disk, never a half-written turn ('last mid-turn save wins' recovery is gone). The __init__ / reset_sheet / close saves OUTSIDE the turn are untouched; a model-call error returns before the recorder family, so failed turns persist nothing (as before).
CHAR-BUG-001.reference: docs/reviews-architecture-refactor.md — map row 'sheet written ... mid-turn AI path <=3 conditional saves' + Phase 4 pre-declared atomic-turn delta (Grok (a) exact replacement) + Phase 4 batch 4 landed (fix executed; per-golden regen justifications).

CHAR-BUG-002.title: english_only_streak double-counted the current turn -> association hard break could fire on the FIRST English-only turn
CHAR-BUG-002.behavior: WAS: conv_session (stage_english_streak) incremented mode_state.english_only_streak for the current turn BEFORE select_mode; modes._select_mode_impl guard 4 then added the current turn AGAIN (eng_streak = state.english_only_streak + 1 when english_only in signals), so the >=2 'stuck English' threshold was met by a single English-only learner turn whenever a hard break was legal. NOW: stage_english_streak is the streak's SINGLE owner (still counts the current turn pre-select); guard 4 reads state.english_only_streak only — the association hard break requires a GENUINE >=2 streak (the SECOND consecutive English-only turn) or no_entiendo. The stored streak values are unchanged; only guard 4's effective count dropped by the double-counted 1 on english_only turns.
CHAR-BUG-002.reference: docs/reviews-architecture-refactor.md — Phase 0 batch 1 landed (found during golden construction; seam defect class: two systems fighting over one behavior) + Phase 4 batch 3 landed (declared fix executed with the family that owns the seam).

CHAR-BUG-006.title: Pre-call fallback image decision treats scene model_lines as 'what the tutor actually said' -> can pick a concept the reply never teaches
CHAR-BUG-006.behavior: WAS: on scene_goal turns stage_fallback_image passed decision.targets.model_lines (the scene's SUGGESTED lines) to assets_for_ai_turn as tutor_models, whose contract says it decides from what the tutor actually said - but it runs BEFORE the model call. It could decide a concept (hola from boat_meet_captain's model lines) absent from the actual reply (Estoy en el bote); the turn then carried miss notes for TWO different concepts (mode attach: bote; fallback: hola), and with a warm cache the irrelevant image would attach (the 2026-07-28 incident class on the conversation path, where require_relevant_to is not threaded). NOW: authored scene scripts are BANNED from the image path (adjudicated Proposal B, BINDING). stage_fallback_image passes NO tutor_models at all - the image relevance base is decision.image_concept (primary; mode attach owns its cache hit/miss + single miss note) and the learner's own words (secondary). The comprehension_repair relevance string threads learner text + targets.last_model/last_try (actual prior tutor performance) - the dead targets.model_lines term was cut per binding item 4 (repair targets never set that key; it must not return for scripts). Accepted narrowing (intentional, adjudicated): a scene image the learner has not typed arrives ONLY via decision.image_concept; no image from parsing suggested lines. Script-derived dual miss notes (bote+hola) are impossible; a learner-text-derived second concept remains lawful and honest (surface-present in the exchange).
CHAR-BUG-006.reference: docs/reviews-architecture-refactor.md - Phase 0 batch 2 landed (found during golden inspection); r5 relevance law scoped only to comprehension_repair/meta turns; 'Policy round: scenes after scripts' (Proposal B AMEND accepted, BINDING) + 'Proposal B pin landed' (2026-07-29).

CHAR-BUG-007.title: Asked-topic registry records pronouns/function keys as topic concepts (location:tu)
CHAR-BUG-007.behavior: WAS: conv_session._topic_nouns fed EVERY association-table key - pronouns, question words, copulas included - into topic_key_for_try's concept scan, so a try like '?Donde estas tu?' registered location:tu instead of the bare location frame; semantically identical asks split across registry keys and pronoun keys leaked into the do_not_re_ask payload. NOW: the palette is ONE table-derived function (session_memory.topic_palette: recorded legacy priority tier - incident nouns ciudad/casa lead, order preserved - then association_table.content_topic_keys, which excludes STRUCTURAL_THEMES/STRUCTURAL_KEYS). Pronouns/question words/copulas/numbers/hay no longer bind as topic concepts: '?Donde estas tu?' registers the bare 'location' frame and identical asks dedupe onto one key (the probe_loop gate now catches the re-ask class the split used to hide). The module default TOPIC_CONCEPT_NOUNS now EQUALS the production palette (the old 21-noun module default was a divergent narrow default).

CHAR-BUG-008.title: Tool band-jump (skills/grammar): a trusted solid_uses claim lets ONE tool call cross emerging -> known
CHAR-BUG-008.behavior: WAS: _clamp_skill_entry trusted the incoming solid_uses claim (uses = max(uses, incoming['solid_uses'])) and also minted +1 per merge on a claimed confidence rise (the rose/promoted heuristic), while _cap_turn_confidence's ceilings use the post-delta STAGED values, so one tool call at prev conf >= 0.55 crossed emerging -> known with zero code-observed uses (verified: prev emerging 0.6 + claim {known, 0.85, solid_uses: 2} -> known 0.85). NOW (honesty law): code-observed evidence (_bump_status on real learner text) is the ONLY source that increments solid_uses. The merge starts from the sheet's own recorded (observed) count, mints no uses of its own (the rose/promoted +1 is gone), and an incoming claim may LOWER the observed count (honest demotion), never raise it. Promotion to known requires prior known (legacy claims on seeded sheets stay honored, test_clamp_keeps_legacy_known_without_uses) or a sub-known EVIDENCE band (emerging/fragile) with observed uses + conf at the gate; every other known claim is silently CLAMPED to emerging (conf capped 0.75) - the _cap_turn_confidence philosophy, not a raise. The known gate (0.80 + 2 solid uses) is therefore uncrossable by claim alone, over any number of calls: the old crossing claim now lands emerging 0.75 with uses 0.
CHAR-BUG-008.reference: docs/reviews-architecture-refactor.md - Phase 1.5 batch 2 landed (tool band-jump verdict, legal-but-logged) + 'CHAR-BUG-008/009 fix landed - REGISTRY CLEAR' (2026-07-29, the declared behavior-change PR: the model's tool loses the power to inflate the diagnosis; PEDAGOGY par.3.2/P7 + par.4.5 capability removal, with the no-claiming rule also added to the update_character_sheet tool description).

CHAR-BUG-008.resolution: FIXED by the CHAR-BUG-008/009 fix PR (2026-07-29): solid_uses claims capped at the observed count (lower-only), merge use-minting removed, known gate keyed to prev band + observed uses; pins inverted + this entry flipped in the same change per the Phase 0 law. CHAR-BUG-009.title: Tool band-jump (lexicon): apply_delta's lexicon branch skips _clamp_skill_entry entirely -> absent -> known at conf 1.0 in one call
CHAR-BUG-009.behavior: WAS: the lexicon dict-merge branch of apply_delta had no per-turn confidence cap and no known gate (only a [0,1] clamp), so ONE tool call minted absent -> known at conf 1.0 when solid_uses was claimed (verified end-to-end through process_turn); the bare-string branch likewise set any claimed status raw (an invalid string minted 'emerging' on an absent entry). NOW: BOTH lexicon branches route through _clamp_skill_entry (via='delta_lexicon') exactly like skills/grammar - no branch mints band/confidence/uses unclamped. The old minting call lands emerging at conf 0.25 (the +0.25 first-appearance ceiling) with solid_uses 0; a known-claim WITHOUT a uses claim lands the same (pre-fix its conf 1.0 survived the cap re-gate demotion - now the merge clamps it); an out-of-vocabulary bare-string claims nothing (absent entry lands band unknown, not the old minted 'emerging').
CHAR-BUG-009.reference: docs/reviews-architecture-refactor.md - Phase 1.5 batch 2 landed (tool band-jump verdict, legal-but-logged) + 'CHAR-BUG-008/009 fix landed - REGISTRY CLEAR' (2026-07-29, the declared behavior-change PR; the registry's prescribed resolution executed: lexicon merge routed through _clamp_skill_entry).
